title: Retire unsupported CUDA/MKL product routes and clear complete dependency policy without exceptions
acceptance: Actual root and workspace all-feature policy must pass unchanged strict licenses/advisories/bans/sources. Retired CUDA/MKL feature requests must fail before compilation across all first-party feature facades; supported CPU and Metal dependency graphs remain selected. Keep CPU inference and hardware inventory; remove CUDA artifact publication and automatic install/build selection. Execute graph and affected runtime/launcher tests with pinned Rust in private state. Full integration and two policy-v6 production packages/rollback are separate integrator gates.
